must_fix.title: Initial walk of a target's shadow root hides content that lies inside another target
must_fix.evidence:
ariaHideOutside.ts:155-159 walks every shadow root returned by getTargetShadowRoots without checking whether its host is already inside a target (visibleNodes). Probe: shadow root S1 holds
…
; S2 is attached to #slot and holds

nits: The comment on getTargetShadowRoots says the roots are returned 'innermost first', but nothing depends on that order, and with several targets the Set only keeps insertion order per target.

report: I'd hold this PR for one bug: with shadow DOM on, it can hide content that sits inside one of the targets. The overlays tests, `yarn eslint packages/@react-aria/overlays` and `yarn check-types` all pass. Everything else the issue asks for works: siblings are hidden at every nesting level, the hosts on the path stay visible, later additions get hidden, announcers and top-layer elements stay visible, targets can sit in different shadow roots, the returned function restores everything, and nothing changes with the flag off. **The bug.** When one target contains the host of another target's shadow root, the initial pass hides content inside the outer target. In the light DOM, nothing inside a target is ever hidden, and this change's own MutationObserver also leaves that same shadow root alone. `getTargetShadowRoots` adds the inner shadow root, and `walk(shadowRoot)` at `ariaHideOutside.ts:157-158` checks its children only against "is it a target / does it contain a target". It never checks whether the shadow root is already inside a target. The observer path does check this (`nodeContains(node, change.target)` at line 171), so the two disagree.
